categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in comprehensive construction services, residential and building development and leasing, industrial plant development and leasing, public infrastructure investment and construction, and building materials wholesale. The main revenue sources are building sales (94.35%) and construction engineering income (4.99%).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes standardized construction processes, construction safety management, and quality control. It integrates construction automation management information systems covering land development to after-sales service. Key technical focuses include green building design, smart building equipment, seismic-resistant construction, energy-saving and carbon reduction equipment, and innovative construction materials like aluminum formwork and gypsum partition walls.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include general consumers for residential buildings, private enterprises and government agencies for construction projects, and industrial clients for factory buildings. The company serves markets mainly in Taiwan, focusing on residential buyers, public infrastructure clients, and industrial sectors requiring new plant construction.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations cover northern, central, and southern Taiwan, with a strong presence in the Greater Kaohsiung area. It is expanding into northern and eastern Taiwan regions and has investment and development projects in Hualien and other areas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the construction supply chain, engaging in land development, construction contracting, building sales, and leasing. It procures raw materials like steel, cement, and concrete directly and collaborates closely with upstream suppliers such as engineering consultants, architects, and building material providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include focusing on mid-to-large scale construction projects, diversifying land acquisition through joint development and investment models, enhancing professional construction and management capabilities, and innovating building styles and business models. R&D efforts target construction cost control, standard construction periods, compliance with building regulations, green building design, smart building technologies, seismic resistance, and energy-saving solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of residential buildings and leasing income, supplemented by construction contracting fees. The company recognizes construction revenue based on the percentage of completion method and derives income from property sales to individual and corporate customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a mature and competitive construction and real estate market in Taiwan, particularly in the Greater Kaohsiung area. It positions itself by emphasizing quality construction, project management excellence, brand reputation, and customer service to differentiate from competitors. It faces challenges from labor shortages, rising material costs, and regulatory changes.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately NT$6.25 billion, a 43.2% increase from the previous year, with net profit around NT$857 million. The company has a stable equity base of about NT$5.79 billion and shows steady growth in assets and retained earnings. Earnings per share increased to NT$3.90, reflecting improved profitability mainly from strong real estate sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes quality, innovation, safety, and service as core values. It offers comprehensive functional residential products designed for convenience and comfort, maintains strict construction quality and safety standards, and provides dedicated customer service from contract signing through after-sales. Its focus on green building, energy efficiency, and sustainable development further differentiates its offerings.
